context: Two sisters reminisce about the past few days
purpose: Teach: 凄く/きのう/ふたつ/即ち/如何/念頭/先ず/一昨日

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、ここ数日いろいろあったよね。一昨日の夜のこと、覚えてる？子どもたちが集まって、凄く賑やかだったでしょ。
lines.en: Hey, a lot happened these past few days, didn't it? Do you remember the night before last? The kids gathered and it was so lively.
lines.style: Warm older-sister opening, casual and chatty, easy familiarity

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん、よく覚えてる。先ず思い出すのはさ、お父さんが急に古いアルバム引っ張り出してきたとこ。
lines.en: Yeah, I remember well. The first thing I think of is Dad suddenly pulling out that old album.
lines.style: Younger-sister casual cadence, dropped particles, easy laughter underneath

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうそう、写真を二枚並べて見せてくれたよね。私たちが浴衣着てるやつ、きのうのことみたいに鮮明でさ。
lines.en: Right, he laid out two photos side by side. The one of us in yukata felt as vivid as if it were yesterday.
lines.style: Tender remembering, soft maternal warmth, voice trailing fondly

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あれ見ると、昔の夏祭り思い出すんだよね。即ち私たちの原点ってやつ？なんてね、ちょっと言い過ぎか。
lines.en: Seeing those, I think of the old summer festivals. In other words, our starting point, sort of? Maybe I'm overdoing it.
lines.style: Slightly teasing self-deprecation, younger sister catching herself mid-thought

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ううん、分かるよ。おばあちゃんの「ご機嫌如何」って挨拶も、ふと念頭に浮かんできてさ。
lines.en: No, I get it. Grandma's 'how do you do' greeting also drifted into my mind just now.
lines.style: Emotional catch in voice, gentle remembrance of grandmother's warmth

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あー、あの口癖ね。私もそれ聞くと、家族って繋がってたんだなあって、しみじみしちゃう。
lines.en: Ahh, that catchphrase. When I hear it too, I really feel how connected our family was, it hits deep.
lines.style: Quiet heartfelt agreement, casual interjection, sisterly resonance

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、来週またみんなで集まろうよ。今度は子どもたちにも昔話、ちゃんと聞かせてあげたいの。
lines.en: Hey, let's all get together again next week. This time I really want to tell the kids those old stories properly.
lines.style: Decisive but soft motherly resolve to pass stories down

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: いいね、賛成。あの子たちにも、おばあちゃんの「ふたつの教え」、ちゃんと伝えとかないとね。
lines.en: Sounds good, I'm in. We should pass on Grandma's 'two teachings' to those kids properly too.
lines.style: Warm sisterly agreement, slightly playful naming, affirming nod
